content.title: Beginner Vegetable Garden Plan
content.body:
## Garden Layout

Planning a small garden bed of 4 feet by 8 feet, which is considered a good size for beginners. The chosen location receives about 6 hours of sunlight daily, and the user needs to verify if this is sufficient for most vegetables.

## Supplies Needed

- [ ] Soil
- [ ] Containers or raised bed materials
- [ ] Seeds
- [ ] Basic gardening tools
- [ ] Simple drip irrigation system for watering

## Additional Considerations

Concerns include pest management, especially rabbits, with a preference for natural deterrents over chemicals. The user also mentions companion planting (e.g., basil near tomatoes) and aims to have everything planted by early May to avoid feeling overwhelmed.
